rebuildReason: The module is rebuilt from scratch
onlyUsers: Reset is only available to signed-in users
chooseArea: Please choose at least one area
noData: There is no data for the chosen areas
lostAdmin: Your own account no longer has administration rights after the reset

apiKeys.label: API keys
apiKeys.description: All API keys of all users (including your own).

users.label: Users
users.description: All user accounts except your own, incl. sessions, sign-in data, role assignments and personal settings.
users.impliesApiKeys: API keys belong to user accounts

roles.label: Roles
roles.description: All custom roles with permissions and assignments. System roles (administrator) remain.

jobs.label: Job runs
jobs.description: Last runs of the background jobs (jobs run again on the next tick).

settings.label: Settings
settings.description: Global and personal settings (incl. module settings). Storage and SMTP access as well as secrets are kept.

audit.label: Audit log
audit.description: All audit entries. Afterwards only the entry about this reset remains.
